method_specification.representation_full.reason:
The paper gives enough to reimplement:
- IC input: 64 uniform periodic sensors, clipping to [1e-4, 1-1e-4], logit, real Fourier coefficients through mode 16 packed as (a0, a1, b1, ..., a16, b16, zero padding) in R^64, divided by the largest retained absolute coefficient over training ICs.
- Coefficient branch: h_mu = P_mu mu + 0.1 tanh E_mu(mu) in R^9, with mu/5 in the first three coordinates.
- IC branch: h_0 = P_0 phi + 0.1 tanh E_0(phi) in R^41, using the first 41 coordinates.
- Fusion: h_s = s * [h_mu; h_0] + b, with tanh MLP widths 3-138-138-138-9 and 64-83-83-83-41.
- Injection: concatenation [h_s; h_c].
- Raw comparator: [2u0(x_j) - 1] concatenated with mu, widths 67-150-150-150-50.
Only trivial details (the initialisation of s and b, and the a0 normalisation convention) are left to the code.
